outcomes.note: Checked DOJ Office of Public Affairs releases, the June 2026 national takedown materials and law-firm roundups through 2026-09-13. The only DOJ criminal prosecution of a telehealth or digital health company for controlled-substance distribution through its platform is still the Done Global case: executives charged 2024-06-13, convicted 2025-11-19, sentenced 2026-07-07. The 2025-12-17 indictment of Done Global Inc. and Mindful Mental Wellness P.A. is the same case (Done set up MMW to keep filling its prescriptions), so the criterion excludes it. The 2026 takedown (455 defendants) names no telehealth-company controlled-substance case; its Aptihealth matter is a civil billing settlement. Cerebral (subpoena, civil settlements) and Truepill (DEA administrative action) do not qualify. DOJ and DEA site search returned 403; coverage rests on OPA releases, takedown pages and roundups.

outcomes.note: Drugs@FDA lists NDA 017442 (Minipress, Pfizer) with its most recent labeling supplements dated 2013-11-04 and 2015-02-27 and no efficacy supplement that adds an indication. The FDA label (s041) and the current generic label (Major Pharmaceuticals, Rev. 05/25, on DailyMed in September 2026) state one indication: treatment of hypertension. No PTSD, nightmare or sleep-disturbance indication appears on any prazosin label as of 2026-09-13; use for PTSD nightmares remains off-label, and guideline or compendium use does not count. The Drugs@FDA free-text search cannot be run by GET, so the NDA overview page and the DailyMed listing were checked instead.

evidence.title: Lykos Therapeutics Announces Complete Response Letter for Midomafetamine Capsules for PTSD
Complete Response letter, NDA 215455, midomafetamine capsules (Lykos Therapeutics), published in the FDA CRL database
MAPS Statement on FDA's Public Release of Complete Response Letter for MDMA-assisted Therapy
BREAKING: FDA Publishes Lykos Therapeutics' MDMA Complete Response Letter (CRL)

outcomes.note: The sponsor disclosed the grounds first: on 2024-08-09 Lykos announced the CRL and said FDA 'requested that Lykos conduct an additional Phase 3 trial to further study the safety and efficacy of midomafetamine', a request for additional safety data together with other deficiencies, which satisfies the criterion on that date. The letter itself (dated 2024-08-08, published by FDA on 2025-09-04) confirms the safety-data grounds: the application did not 'establish the safety' of the product; unreported adverse events at two or more sites raised 'substantial concerns about the reliability of the safety data'; phase 3 laboratory data (liver analytes, electrolytes) were absent and the cardiac safety assessment was incomplete; FDA asked for a new trial to 'adequately characterize the safety'. No PDUFA extension was involved; FDA acted on the NDA that was under review in June 2024.

evidence.title: Lilly completes acquisition of AtaiBeckley for mental health drugs

outcomes.note: Series: Nasdaq close multiplied by the share count on the latest 10-Q cover (370,864,669 as of 2026-08-07). The highest close in the final months of trading was $7.44 on 2026-08-25, giving $2.76B (stored as realized_value); the last closes before Lilly's $6.75-cash-plus-CVR takeover closed on 2026-09-11 were $7.35 (2026-09-10 and 09-11), giving $2.73B. Earlier history is far lower: IPO-day cap $2.29B on 2021-06-18 and year-end caps of $1.22B (2021), $0.44B (2022), $0.23B (2023), $0.22B (2024) and $1.49B (2025). No close ever reached $10B. Closing prices come from Yahoo Finance and Stock Analysis, which both report Nasdaq closes (nasdaq.com timed out). ATAI stopped trading after the acquisition with no successor listing, so no later close can change this result.

outcomes.note: No FDA, EMA, MHRA, TGA or other approval exists for any psychedelic developed, owned or partnered by atai Life Sciences or its successor AtaiBeckley (a Lilly subsidiary since 2026-09-11). FDA's 2026 novel approvals list holds no psychedelic or entactogen; the company's Q2 2026 10-Q calls itself clinical-stage; Lilly's July 2026 deal terms place BPL-003 (mebufotenin, 5-MeO-DMT) in Phase 3 and VLS-01 (DMT) in Phase 2b, with CVR payments contingent on future US approval. COMP360 (Compass Pathways, in which atai held only a shrinking equity stake, not a licence or partnership) is still in rolling NDA submission with modules due in Q4 2026 and no approval. outcomes.note: Lykos said on 2024-08-09 it would seek a meeting to ask FDA to reconsider the CRL. After that Type A meeting Lykos reported (2024-10-21) a 'path forward' that still included an additional Phase 3 trial plus a third-party review of prior data, so FDA did not withdraw its request. No formal dispute resolution decision or reconsideration grant has been published by FDA, Lykos or its successor Resilient Pharmaceuticals through 2026-09-13. Resilient's August 2026 resubmission without a new Phase 3 relies on third-party VA data, a 32-subject cardiac safety study and an audit; reporting shows no FDA statement waiving the Phase 3 request, no acceptance-for-review notice and no goal date, and a resubmission accepted for review would not count in any case. The Lykos and Resilient websites could not be read (redirect loop and empty page).

outcomes.note: First qualifying filing found: the securities class action Kachrodia v. Acadia Healthcare Company, Inc., M.D. Tenn. No. 3:24-cv-01238, docketed 2024-10-16 (amended 2024-10-21; Dyar followed 2024-10-29; consolidated complaint 2025-07-10; motion to dismiss denied 2026-07-24). The complaint alleges that Acadia detained 'patients against their will, even when such detention was not medically necessary' and misled investors about it, the conduct described in the NYT investigation, so a shareholder class action counts under the criterion. Acadia first disclosed it in the 10-Q filed 2024-10-30. The only earlier post-2024-09-04 federal suit naming Acadia in RECAP (Jenkins, W.D. Tenn., 2024-09-18) is an overtime case. State-court patient suits filed between 2024-09-04 and 2024-10-16 could not be excluded (no state docket search), so the date could move earlier if one surfaces.
